name: CN_PAYMENT_PLANS_ALL_B
description: This table stores information regarding the payment plans used to affect the compensation paid to  sales people

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: PAYMENT_PLAN_ID
columns.description: Primary key

columns.name: MINIMUM_AMOUNT
columns.description: Minimum amount that should be paid per pay period

columns.name: MAXIMUM_AMOUNT
columns.description: Maximum amount that can be paid per pay period

columns.name: MIN_RECOVER_FLAG
columns.description: Valid  values are Y and N.  If the amount earned falls short of minimum, then the difference  is recoverable in the subsequent periods only if this flag is  Y

columns.name: PAY_EXCESS_LATER_FLAG
columns.description: Valid values are Y and N.  If the amount  earned exceeds the maximum amount,  then the difference is payable in the subsequent periods if this flag is set to Y

columns.name: MAX_RECOVERY_AMOUNT
columns.description: This column holds the maximum credit type units  that can be recovered.

columns.name: CREDIT_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the credit type of the payment plan

columns.name: PAY_INTERVAL_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Identifier which represent the interval type for which the payment plan is effective. The valid interval types are Period, Quarter and Year.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Effective start date

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Effective end date

columns.name: DRAW_PERCENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Draw amount percent.Added for expression based recovery and draw

columns.name: DRAW_EXPRESSION_ID
columns.description: Draw expression ID.Added for expression based recovery and draw

columns.description: Recover expression ID.Added for expression based recovery and draw

columns.name: RECOVER_PERCENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Recover amount percent.Added for expression based recovery and draw

columns.name: RECOVERY_END_INTERVAL_ID
columns.description: Recovery end interval Id.Added for expression based recovery and draw

columns.name: RECOVERY_START_INTERVAL_ID
columns.description: Recovery start interval Id.Added for expression based recovery and draw

columns.name: PAYMENT_PLAN_CATEGORY
